items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Freddie Jenkins played the high notes. We used to call him Little Posey.

ctx.x: Freddie Jenkins played the high notes. We used to call him Little Posey. He was on the end. He was a small fellow and very flashy, and it seems that every man that became a member of that band had some quality that attrac-

ted the public.
Now Little Posey was very flashy and was used so many, many times for his flashing. He just fit, everything just fit in like a puzzle in this odd picture, and now Little Posey -- who, incidentally, I hear is still alive -- has long been forgotten, seemingly. He's down in Texas. I hear he's a deputy sheriff in Fort Worth, or someplace down in there. And because of some physical ailments he's no longer able to play horn -- a horn, and all of these people all the way along fit into this picture, and…
